translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Tema rooteentsi ikami pinkathari David, ikaemakaan-takiri Salomón, ikantziri:
“¡Notyomí! Kimitaka rooteentsi nojoweyi, niyaatatyee jempe ikinayitzi maawoeni atziri. Pitonta-shire-pero-te eeroka, pishirampari-pero-te.

Panta-piinteero rompera-tzimiri Tajorentsi, pithotyaa-yiteero iwinkakaantani, ikantakaantani, ishineta-kaantani eejatzi ishintsi-thatan-tziri, okaatzi jankina-teenchari ñaantsi riyotahaeri owaejatziteni Moisés, rootaki iyaatan-tyaari kameetha oetarika pantayi-teeri, tekatsi awijimo-temini jempe-rika pikinayite.

Ari imonkaa-terori Tajorentsi okaatzi ikashiya-kaakinari, ikantakina: “Kyaari-pero-rika ikemijanteena ikaate picharini-teeyaari, kameetha-rika roshire-teena, rawentaa-shire-teena, ashi rowaero ikaate picharini-teeyaari ipinkathari-wenteeri pisheninka-paeni Israel-paeni.”
Tema makoryaaki David. Ikiteetakiri iiteetziro “Inampi David”.

Ojamani ipinkathari-wentakiri David paerani isheninka-paeni Israel-paeni okaatzi 40 ojarentsi. Retakawo ipinkatharitaki nampitsiki Aripero-taariniki okaatzi 7 ojarentsi, eejatzi nampitsiki Aapatziyaweniki okaatzi 33 ojarentsi.
Ikanta retanakawo ipinkathari-tanaki Salomón, ipoyaataari ipaapate. Riitaki matakirori ijeekakaantaki kameetha.

footnotes.text: 2.10 makoryaaki = maaki = jatashire-tee ijeeki ishire iwaejatzite-paeni; Inampi David = Aapatziyaweni.
